title: AI slop is everywhere
description: How you can stand out in a world full of AI slop
transcript: In the world of AI Slack, how do you stand out? A lot of people produce an AI outputs that they're not really reading, but then they're asking their team to read. And I mean, it's beautiful and well-written and research and graphs and [ __ ] icons and emojis and all that stuff. And I'm like, "Bro, stop it." Dude, did you read my update? I'm like, "Not only did the AI write it, AI posted it." It literally says posted by Maness or posted by Clouder. [ __ ] AI generated. I'm like, "You didn't read it." If you're producing massive amounts of updates and posting it in Slack and they were generated with AI, you're kind of a [ __ ] [ __ ] dude.
